name: Superhouse Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1980, Superhouse Ltd manufactures and trades Leather, Leather Goods and Textile Goods, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SL is a part of Superhouse group of companies. It is a manufacturer and exporter of finished leather and also deals in leather footwear, other leather products, textile garments and horse 
riding products

pros: Stock is trading at 0.38 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 1.79% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 3.22% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.14.5 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 6.83% of profits over last 3 years
